_: Written by `ci-video narrate`. Records which line each mp3 is a read of, in which voice, on which engine, at what prosody — so a later edit to any of those can be detected instead of silently keeping the old recording. Commit this with the mp3s.

open.text: Photo Time Machine does that work on hardware you already own.

drop-media.text: Open the viewer and drop one in. It goes to your own server, not a queue.

choose-engine.text: Name the engine yourself, or leave it on auto and let the server infer it.

job-running.text: It reads the input, picks an engine, and runs the job where the file already is.

from-memory.text: Your Companion already holds your library. Turn one into 3D without uploading anything.

engines.text: Preview lays the picture on a plane. Depth adds real parallax. Many views rebuild the scene.

explore-gallery.text: Finished assets land in the gallery. Click one to open it.

orbit-memory.text: Hide the panel and orbit the memory itself. Nothing left your hardware to render it.

magic-window.text: Turn on XR and your webcam tracks your head. The screen stops being a picture and becomes a window.

share-link.text: The address bar is the share link. It points at your box.

companion-native.text: Agents create and share these over MCP. The files stay on your hardware.

close.text: Photo Time Machine, from Companion Intelligence. UnCloud your life.

flat.text: A photograph has no depth. Your own server works it out.

most-people-stop.text: Depth normally means a GPU you do not own, or a service that keeps your file.

plate-to-space.text: This one is the Preview engine: the picture itself, lifted onto a plane and turned.

whose-hardware.text: Move around it. The panel names the engine, and the link points at your own box.

stays-yours.text: The file, the engine and the link all stay on hardware you own. Nothing to cancel.
